tools.name: list_products
tools.when_to_use: Browse or page through supplier products, optionally filtered by supplier or the canonical product they map to.
tools.when_not_to_use: Fetching one product you already have the id for (use get_product).

tools.name: get_product
tools.when_to_use: Fetch a single supplier product by its supplier_product_id (ULID), including its canonical mapping.
tools.when_not_to_use: Searching or listing without an id (use list_products).

tools.name: list_product_offers
tools.when_to_use: List every supplier-account offer (price and availability) for a supplier product.
tools.when_not_to_use: You only need the cheapest option (use get_best_offer).

tools.name: get_best_offer
tools.when_to_use: Get the cheapest current offer (by UAH price) across all supplier accounts for a supplier product.
tools.when_not_to_use: You need all offers or their terms (use list_product_offers).

tools.name: get_offer_price_history
tools.when_to_use: Retrieve the time series of observed prices for one offer over a date range.
tools.when_not_to_use: You only need aggregates like min/max/avg (use get_offer_price_stats).

tools.name: get_offer_price_stats
tools.when_to_use: Get aggregate UAH-price statistics (min/max/avg/last/count) for one offer over a date range.
tools.when_not_to_use: You need the individual points (use get_offer_price_history).

tools.name: get_offer_price_daily
tools.when_to_use: Get per-day price buckets (count/min/max/avg/last in UAH) for one offer — ideal for charting price dynamics over weeks or months.
tools.when_not_to_use: You need raw intra-day points (use get_offer_price_history) or a single aggregate over the whole period (use get_offer_price_stats).

tools.name: hybrid_search
tools.when_to_use: Find supplier products by free-text meaning (names, specs, codes, any language) — lexical + vector retrieval, reranked.
tools.when_not_to_use: You already know an exact id or GTIN (use list_products / list_canonical_products filters), or you want one result per platform product (use canonical_hybrid_search).

tools.name: canonical_hybrid_search
tools.when_to_use: Free-text search that returns canonical (platform) products — one hit per product instead of per supplier version.
tools.when_not_to_use: You need supplier-level hits with supplier codes (use hybrid_search).

tools.name: get_curation_queue
tools.when_to_use: List supplier-to-canonical match suggestions awaiting an operator decision.
tools.when_not_to_use: Automated flows — curation is an operator action requiring the matching:curate scope.

tools.name: confirm_curation_link
tools.when_to_use: Confirm the suggested canonical for a supplier product (operator decision); emits matching.link.confirmed.
tools.when_not_to_use: You are unsure of the match — inspect the queue first, or reject it.

tools.name: reject_curation_link
tools.when_to_use: Reject the suggested canonical for a supplier product (operator decision).
tools.when_not_to_use: The suggestion is correct — confirm it instead.

tools.name: list_canonical_products
tools.when_to_use: Browse or page through the confirmed canonical (platform) products, optionally filtered by GTIN.
tools.when_not_to_use: Fetching one canonical you already have the id for (use get_canonical_product), or searching by meaning (use the search service).

tools.name: get_canonical_product
tools.when_to_use: Fetch a single canonical product card by its canonical_product_id (ULID).
tools.when_not_to_use: Listing or searching without an id (use list_canonical_products).

tools.name: get_curation_stats
tools.when_to_use: Get operator-dashboard counters: pending reviews, confirmed canonical products, and decisions broken down by action.
tools.when_not_to_use: You need the individual decisions (use get_curation_decisions) or the review queue (use get_curation_queue).

tools.name: get_curation_decisions
tools.when_to_use: Page through the append-only decision journal (audit log of operator confirm/reject/create-new/merge actions).
tools.when_not_to_use: You only need aggregate counts (use get_curation_stats).

tools.name: create_new_canonical
tools.when_to_use: Create a brand-new canonical for a supplier product when no existing canonical fits (operator decision).
tools.when_not_to_use: An existing canonical is a correct match — confirm that link instead.

tools.name: merge_canonical_products
tools.when_to_use: Merge one canonical product into another, re-linking all of its member supplier products (operator decision).
tools.when_not_to_use: The two canonicals are genuinely different products — merging is hard to reverse.

tools.name: get_sync_accounts
tools.when_to_use: List each supplier account's sync state (kind, mode, interval, last requested, next due, status) for monitoring.
tools.when_not_to_use: You want to force a sync now (use trigger_sync). Returns no credentials or financial terms.

tools.name: trigger_sync
tools.when_to_use: Manually request an immediate sync for one account (stages sync.job.requested); use when data looks stale.
tools.when_not_to_use: The account is already syncing on schedule and its status is ok (check get_sync_accounts first).
